requirement: Where subagents are unavailable, the `habeas-requirements` skill MUST direct agents to review each group themselves against the review prompt of {cite}`requirements.cli.requirements_review_skill.review_prompt`, one group at a time, before presenting any group to the user.
rationale:
The subject `requirements.cli.requirements_review_skill.review.fallback` has these obligations. The skill must direct agents, when subagents are unavailable, to:
(a) review each group themselves,
(b) review against the review prompt,
(c) review one group at a time, and
(d) do all of this before presenting any group to the user.

The only test, `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[the_requirements_skill_reviews_groups_itself_without_subagents]`, is marked with `{test}`. It parses the `habeas-requirements` skill's Workflow section using the helpers `workflow_steps` and `step_of`. Those helpers are reached from the marked test and need no marking of their own. `step_of` panics if no step contains the phrase, so the check cannot pass vacuously.

The test makes two checks:
1. It requires some step to contain the phrase "If you can't start subagents, review each group yourself against the prompt, one group at a time". That covers the unavailable-subagents condition and obligations (a), (b) and (c).
2. It asserts that this step's number is strictly less than the number of the step containing "Present each group to the user". That covers obligation (d). The skill text in `assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` puts the fallback in step 3 and presentation in step 4. If the fallback moved into or after the presentation step, the assertion would fail.

One weakness remains. The test does not verify that "the prompt" is the review prompt of `requirements.cli.requirements_review_skill.review_prompt`, which is `references/review-prompt.md`. That file is named in the same step 3 that the test locates. This is a small gap in the literal-phrase style of check, not a missing scenario. The content of the review prompt is the cited requirement's own obligation and is not assessed here. The requirement has no other input classes or boundaries, so I found no unmet testing criterion.

text: Where subagents are unavailable, the `habeas-requirements` skill MUST direct agents to review each group themselves against the review prompt of {cite}`requirements.cli.requirements_review_skill.review_prompt`, one group at a time, before presenting any group to the user.

The `habeas-requirements` skill MUST supply the review prompt that each group's reviewer follows. The prompt MUST direct the reviewer not to edit files. It MUST direct the reviewer to make mechanical changes itself in the revised text it returns, and to return design questions for the user.
